title: Saved options, version 1
description: Every key of the Android SharedPreferences file "settings", as a map of key to stored value. A key that is absent takes its default. Keys not listed here are ignored by the app, so additionalProperties stays true. Frozen once released: never edit, add a v2.json.

spell.description: Options.spell: fix OCR typos with a spell checker in a new book.

trim.description: Options.trimFront: drop the front matter of a new book.

merge.description: Options.mergeFragments: join text fragments that were split across lines or pages.

clean.description: Options.cleanText: drop back matter, tables, lists and page numbers.

footnotes.description: Options.footnotes: keep a scanned book's footnotes as unspoken annotations.

contents.description: Options.contents: keep a contents page out of the speech, shown at the start of the reading view.

voice.description: Options.voice, a Voice enum constant name. An unknown or absent name falls back to the legacy "natural" key (true: KOKORO, false: PHONE), or to PIPER when that is absent too.

theme.description: Options.theme, a ThemeMode enum constant name. An unknown name falls back to SYSTEM.

summaries.description: SummarySettings.enabled: summarise each chapter of a new book with the small language model that runs on the device (LocalModel), for an overview and key lessons. Turning it on starts the download of the model.

summary-audio.description: SummarySettings.audio: speak each chapter summary into its own clip, in the voice chosen in "voice". Only used while "summaries" is true.

natural.description: Legacy, read only, never written now. The first build had a Natural voice switch; true means voice KOKORO and false the phone's voice, when "voice" is absent or unknown. Nothing removes it, so it may stay beside "voice".

speed.description: Playback speed, one of Player.SPEEDS. Read as any float; written only from that list.

asked-notifications.description: True once the notification permission was asked, so it is asked once only.

language.description: CatalogueLanguage: the Catalogue's language, a Gutenberg language code or "all". Absent means none chosen yet, which acts as "all". The old English only switch was never stored, so it has no migration.

catalogue-languages.description: Catalogue: the languages of the last book list read, "code:count" pairs joined by commas, e.g. "en:60000,fr:2000". Pairs that do not parse are skipped on read.
